title: Stateful telemetry reconstruction for Console usage (retro-ingest pipeline)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: We discovered multiple gaps in Console usage metrics after a schema migration and intermittent event-filtering bug in the event forwarder during the 2025.12 deploy window. The current one-off backfills we've run are slow, brittle, and not idempotent, which prevents safe retries and blocks reproducible QA. Goal: implement a stateful retro-ingest/reconstruction pipeline that can replay historical Console telemetry from raw event streams, reconstruct derived metrics (per-token latency histogram, route-level cost attribution, and rollout sampling markers), and write results into the analytics warehouse in an idempotent, resumable way. Scope: design checkpointing, deterministic ordering for dependent aggregations, migrate the existing backfill tooling to the new orchestrator, add monitoring + health checks, and provide an operator runbook. Out of scope: changing the upstream event schema or modifying live production routing.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Operator can start a reconstruction job for an arbitrary 7-day range; job can be paused and resumed without duplicating rows. 2) Reconstructed metrics match golden set for daily totals within 0.1% for tested ranges. 3) All writes are idempotent using reconciliation keys and upserts; there is a reconciliation job to compare raw vs reconstructed totals. 4) Alerts fire if processing lag > 12 hours or if >1% of events fail checksum validation. 5) Migration playbook documented and rehearsed in staging.
design_decisions: - Use time-windowed, shardable checkpoints (S3-backed checkpoints with sequence tokens) instead of single global checkpoints to allow parallelism across date/hours. - Emit deterministic message sort keys based on (source_stream, event_timestamp, event_id) to ensure stable aggregation. - Implement at-least-once read + idempotent upserts on the warehouse using deterministic reconciliation keys (hash of event_id + ingest_version). - Prefer Delta Lake upserts for batch writes to preserve efficient partition pruning. - Provide a lightweight coordinator service (stateless controller + durable checkpoint store) rather than heavy stateful workers; workers are horizontally scalable and pull work from the coordinator.
tradeoffs: - Extra storage overhead for checkpoints and reconciliation indexes, but significant reduction in operator toil and risk of double-counting. - Deterministic ordering increases CPU for pre-sort but avoids nondeterministic aggregation variance. - Chose Delta Lake upserts (requires cluster config) over raw append + eventual reconciliation to simplify correctness guarantees.
work_items: - Implement coordinator API (start/pause/resume/cancel) - Worker change: deterministic sorter + checkpoint commit - Warehouse write adapter for idempotent Delta upserts - Backfill cli for operators with dry-run and reconcile flags - End-to-end test harness and small-scale dry runs - Dashboards and alerting rules - Runbook and migration rehearsal
testing_plan: 1) Unit test deterministic sort and checkpoint commit. 2) Integration: run on a 48-hour sample window with synthetic event anomalies (out-of-order, duplicates, missing event_id) and verify reconciliation metrics. 3) Staging dress rehearsal: full 7-day window with staging data, measure throughput and resource costs. 4) Canary in production on a single non-critical tenant, compare totals against live pipeline for 24 hours.
monitoring_and_alerting: Grafana dashboard: Console Reconstruct Overview (latency, processed_events/sec, checkpoint_lag, failed_events_pct). Alerts: reconstruct-lag>12h (page), failed-events>1% (p1 email), reconciliation-delta>0.5% (pager on weekdays), coordinator-heartbeat-missing>10m (pager).
rollout_plan: 1) Merge infra and worker PRs behind feature flag. 2) Run small range dry runs in staging. 3) Shift operator to new CLI for production one-off reconstructions. 4) Run full 7-day run for non-critical tenant and validate. 5) Proceed to company-wide replays after signoff. 6) Once stable, deprecate the old ad-hoc backfill scripts.
rollback_plan: If reconstructed totals diverge >1% from legacy pipeline or reconciliation fails, stop further writes, revert to snapshot partition (Delta time travel), and escalate to incident channel. Operators can resume old backfill workflow while we investigate.
